# Photo Validation Fixture

`face-portrait.jpg` is the unmodified portrait test fixture from Google's
TensorFlow.js face-detection repository, distributed under Apache-2.0:
https://github.com/tensorflow/tfjs-models/blob/master/face-detection/test_data/portrait.jpg

The license is bundled at `models/face-detection/LICENSE`. Tests generate blurred,
underexposed, overexposed and multi-face variants in memory.
